no access-list 150
access-list 150 permit ip 10.1.0.0   0.0.0.0   255.255.0.0   0.0.0.0

!
no route-map MyMap_2_1
!
route-map MyMap_2_1 permit 1
 match ip address 150
 set metric 10
 set community  1:200 additive
exit
!
router bgp 1
!

 neighbor 10.0.0.2 route-map MyMap_2_1 out
!
exit
